WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName,
        f.DateKey,
        d.IsWorkDay,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, f.DateKey, d.IsWorkDay
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    round(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd'), 2)  AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
    round(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 2)  AS avg_weekday_day_sales,
    round(
        avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'),
        2
    )                                                   AS abs_diff,
    round(
        (avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'))
        * 100.0 / nullif(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0),
        2
    )                                                   AS pct_bigger_than_weekday
FROM daily_sales
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY pct_bigger_than_weekday DESC
